execution_gate.reason: Wait for GPU forward/backward preflight and main-agent acceptance before launch; this gate is not due to unfinished Inter-X work.

data.variants: left/right swap x coordinate anchor x final person order

model.rationale: Only the native down_t setting changes from 2 to 1: token density doubles, while one down/up-sampling stage and its associated residual blocks are removed. Parameter count and receptive field therefore also change, so this is not a bitrate-only causal isolation. Feature partitions 512/12, latent partitions 384/128, and 1024 codes per codebook remain unchanged.
model.quantizer_rationale: Unchanged from v3: FP32 assignment/EMA, clear usage each 21 updates, initialize replacement EMA sum/count together. This experiment changes temporal compression, not the quantizer mechanism.

optimization.batch_rationale: Do not use gradient accumulation with the EMA-reset quantizers: each microbatch updates codebook EMA state, so accumulation would not reproduce one larger batch. Increase the physical batch only after a measured memory preflight.
optimization.schedule: linear warmup then cosine to zero at the fixed 30000-step full endpoint; the 10000-step pilot is a pause, not a scheduler endpoint

loss.commitment_count: once for the joint two-codebook VQ

automatic_validation.rng_policy: validation is observational and restores Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG and model mode

decision_after_10k.comparison: Compare against v3 at the same optimizer step on the frozen 480-request official val set, and compare with the formal official InterMask val score; do not use test results for this decision.
decision_after_10k.shared_val_scorer: tools/score_interhuman_vq_validation.py; 480 val requests, five released batches of 96, seed 20260130
decision_after_10k.selected_hhc_vq_rescore: tools/evaluate_hhc_interhuman_vq_validation.py; independently reload the manifest-selected full-endpoint checkpoint and report the identical metric core
decision_after_10k.final_val_comparison: tools/compare_interhuman_vq_validation.py; fail closed unless HHC and released InterMask scores use the same 480 requests and byte-identical evaluator provenance
decision_after_10k.if_quality_improves: Continue the same run to the fixed 30000-step endpoint and compare at matched optimizer steps; do not start MGT before the official-val comparison is accepted.
decision_after_10k.if_no_improvement: Stop after the 10000-step decision point; do not add a sweep or start MGT.
decision_after_10k.formal_test: Only after official-val selection; use all 20 frozen test replications and identical InterCLIP scorer
